limitations: Model 1 of each deposited file only; the per-model spread is in the P1 census, not in the scenes.

The data-true reader shares the donor table, the side-chain atom lists, the 2.5 angstrom glow line and the spline sampling with the builder; it is independent in parsing (MDAnalysis), selection and arithmetic.
The glow line is a display rule, not the metal-site window: a bond can glow and still fail the witness (for example a Zn-S of 2.461 A).
The scenes have no ROUTEs or scripts, so there is no behaviour to judge; the camera is the only thing that moves.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.

not_run.reason: Read 32 frames, one per scene Viewpoint (X_ITE 16.7.0; headless Chromium 153 on SwiftShader; 960x720; Viewpoints bound through SAI set_bind; eyes-render-log.json). Every frame draws its zinc, donors, bonds and labels; none is blank (lowest lit share 0.113, 6DNH C302); 0 console messages. Short bonds glow gold (S) and blue (N); the long cryo-EM bonds draw dark and thin as the rule says (6DNH C301 2.80, C303 2.75; 6FUW C201 2.66 and 2.78; 6URO C302 2.99, C303 2.52) and 6DNH C302 shows two donors. Left as found: neighbouring sites crowd the background of 1ZAA C201 and 6DNH C301, and a side chain crosses a few labels. The frames were read on the previous build (same atoms, bonds and Viewpoints); this build's frames differ from them in at most 0.0002 of their pixels. X_ITE 16.6.0 under the same rig gave 32 of 32 byte-identical frames. A model reading of pictures: graded S.
